verdict.rationale: LanceDB's core is Apache-2.0 open source and embeddable. It runs on local disk or any S3-compatible store, and a community user ran it inside an Electron app, so a developer can prototype at no cost by self-hosting. There is no evidence of a hosted or cloud free tier, its limits, or how it upgrades to the paid Enterprise offering. Missing for 10: documented managed free-tier allowances/limits, explicit pricing page evidence, independent confirmation of the free-to-paid path.
